Distance: 1350 Conditions: 13mph Head wind with a bit more chop for the last 400m. 

The lower crews for both teams competed in complete lineups on 4/11 but the 1Vs did not due to academic obligations. This race was for the Mayor’s Cup which is decided solely by the outcome of the 1V race. CRLS retains the cup. 

Thanks to both coxswains for steering good lines and both crews for fitting in a mid-week race.
